sections.title: THE RULES OF THE GAME
sections.subtitle: Demo Game — Season II
sections.footer: — As it is written, so shall it be played —

sections.head: The Realm and the Season
sections.body: A season lasts four weeks, split into cycles. Each realm is ruled by one player, and the realm's fate is decided by its territories.

sections.head: Territories
sections.body: Each territory is a map of the realm. Holding it grants resources and access to unique actions.

sections.head: Attacks
sections.body: Attacks are declared in the war council channel. The defender may spend one defense point to redirect the assault.

sections.head: Technologies
sections.body: Technologies are bought with gear points. Each one grants a special action, usable once per cycle unless stated otherwise.
